name: cinderblock-site-builder
description: Bedrock designs an Astro + Tailwind site (guardrail-protected against prompt injection), built with the runtime's bundled npm and uploaded (source + dist/) to the preview S3 bucket. Uses the AWS SDK v3 bundled in the Lambda Node.js runtime.
devDependenciesComment: Test-only — never bundled into lambda.zip (build-lambda.sh zips an explicit file list, not node_modules). Lets `node --test` import bedrock.mjs/reviews.mjs without hitting the AWS SDK the Lambda runtime provides at deploy time.
